name: active-oberon
description: Active Oberon syntax and the minia2 language server. Installed from the .vsix that ships with the SDK -- there is no marketplace listing.

activeOberon.server.path.markdownDescription: The `ob` command of the SDK. Empty means `$A2_OB`, else `ob` on the PATH. A Docker fallback is written here too: set the path to `docker` and the arguments to `["run","--rm","-i","-v","${workspaceFolder}:/work","minia2-sdk","lsp","--live"]`.

activeOberon.server.args.description: Arguments the server is started with. ${workspaceFolder} is substituted.

activeOberon.stdlibSource.description: Passed as $A2_STDLIB_SRC: where the standard library sources are, for go-to-definition into them.

activeOberon.symbolDir.description: Passed as $A2_SYMS: a prebuilt symbol directory (…/target/Linux64/bin), so imports resolve from build artifacts instead of on-demand compilation.

activeOberon.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between VS Code and the server.

activeOberon.debug.args.markdownDescription: Arguments the debug adapter is started with, on the same command as the server (`activeOberon.server.path`). The Docker fallback needs the whole line here too: `["run","--rm","-i","-v","${workspaceFolder}:/work","minia2-sdk","dap"]`. ${workspaceFolder} is substituted.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A modifier that switches a safety of the language off: UNSAFE, UNCHECKED, UNCOOPERATIVE, UNTRACED.
A modifier that keeps the checks on.

program.description: The .Mod file to compile with --debug and run.

procedure.description: The exported procedure to run. `ob run` defaults to Do.

configurationSnippets.label: Active Oberon: run this module
configurationSnippets.description: Compile the open file with --debug and run its Do

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server compiles the modules of the folder it is opened on, which means running the compiler over code the workspace supplies. That is not something to do in a folder one has not trusted.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The server is a local process that reads the files from disk.
